== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Advocates are a group of self-proclaimed protectors of galactic civilization that originated as a band of vigilantes. Over time, they evolved into an organization with quasi-official [[Authority|authority]] that provides essential services to those living outside the reach of standard law enforcement. Their reputation varies significantly across different territories: in the [[Free Worlds]], they are viewed as heroic role models and a highly respected institution, whereas in the Alliance, they are seen as an ineffective force that refuses to share their proprietary [[Aethertech]]. Internal divisions have historically plagued the organization, specifically regarding whether they should expand their influence throughout the galaxy or remain within their established mandate. The group has also faced accusations of corruption, with some claiming they prioritize protecting their own reputation above all else. They were closely associated with the figure known as [[Starhammer]], and his departure left their headquarters in disrepair and the organization lacking direction. Despite these challenges and periods of instability, some members remain dedicated to rebuilding the group.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Originally a group of vigilantes in the [[Free Worlds]] that gained quasi-official [[Authority|authority]], [[the Advocates]] are an organization dedicated to protecting the galaxy through applications. Members wear blue and white uniforms and operate a fleet of one thousand ships, often utilizing [[Aethertech]] to seal away unidentified relics. While they possess the [[Authority|authority]] to arrest individuals for crimes like piracy and sabotage, they do not execute their prisoners and instead perform ship inspections. Despite being described as corrupt, the group maintains a presence near the [[Scylon system]] and employs [[Undermaker]] for disaster relief. The organization has faced significant conflict, including wars waged by the narrator and battles involving [[Starhammer]], eventually facing [[destruction]] at the hands of [[Omega]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Advocates initially targeted the narrator and [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]] by placing a bounty on their heads. This group was also identified as a potential force behind various subspace blockades. Despite facing internal instability, the organization remained active and even engaged in a conflict with [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]. Ultimately, [[the Advocates]] reached their end when the group fell.}}
